run_sequential_mnist_training: run the sequential MNIST training loop with an IRNN model using Salina agents and argparse CLI
create_sequential_mnist_dataset: create a SequentialMNIST dataset that loads MNIST data with optional pixel permutation for sequential input
build_irnn_model: build an IRNN recurrent neural network with identity initialization for sequential MNIST classification
test_irnn_agent: test the IRNNAgent model on a test dataloader agent and return loss and accuracy metrics
create_irnn_agent: create an IRNNAgent that wraps an IRNN model and processes workspace inputs to produce prediction logits
